name: launch-sales-np
description: Sales follow-through for a Nepal launch: saved replies and chat replies for Messenger, Instagram, WhatsApp, Viber and comments ('price?', 'COD milcha?', 'original ho?', size, haggling, confirmation, complaints) in Romanized Nepali, Nepali or English; sorting launch comments and inquiries into ready buyers, interested, resellers and complaints with reply drafts; consent-based SMS, Viber and email launch messages; and Daraz-style marketplace listings. Drafts only; never sends; no pressure tactics.
